name: GitHub
description: Connect a GitHub App to read installed repositories and opt in to bounded issue and pull-request writes.

capabilities.description: Read the signed-in GitHub account and accessible TritonAI GitHub App installations.
Search and read bounded repository, file, issue, pull-request, commit-check, and Actions metadata from repositories where the GitHub App is installed.
Create or narrowly update issues and add issue comments. Cannot delete issues or manage repository settings.
Create pull requests from existing branches, add comments, and submit reviews. Cannot merge pull requests or write commits or branches.

tools.name: github.identity.get
tools.description: Read the connected GitHub account.

tools.name: github.installations.list
tools.description: List bounded GitHub App installations accessible to the connected account.

tools.name: github.repositories.list
tools.description: List bounded repositories available through the connected GitHub App.

tools.name: github.repositories.get
tools.description: Read metadata for one exact repository.

tools.name: github.repositories.search
tools.description: Search repositories with a bounded text query.

tools.name: github.contents.get
tools.description: Read one exact bounded file at an optional repository ref.

tools.name: github.code.search
tools.description: Search code in one exact repository with a bounded query.

tools.name: github.issues.list
tools.description: List bounded issues in one repository.

tools.name: github.issues.search
tools.description: Search issues and pull requests in one exact repository.

tools.name: github.issues.get
tools.description: Read one exact issue or pull-request issue record.

tools.name: github.issues.comments.list
tools.description: List bounded comments for one issue or pull request.

tools.name: github.issues.create
tools.description: Create one issue with bounded text, labels, and assignees.

tools.name: github.issues.update
tools.description: Narrowly update one issue title, body, state, labels, or assignees.

tools.name: github.issues.comment.create
tools.description: Add one bounded comment to an issue.

tools.name: github.pulls.list
tools.description: List bounded pull requests in one repository.

tools.name: github.pulls.get
tools.description: Read one exact pull request.

tools.name: github.pulls.reviews.list
tools.description: List bounded review metadata for one pull request.

tools.name: github.pulls.review-comments.list
tools.description: List bounded inline review comments for one pull request.

tools.name: github.pulls.create
tools.description: Create a pull request between existing branches without writing commits.

tools.name: github.pulls.comment.create
tools.description: Add one bounded conversation comment to a pull request.

tools.name: github.pulls.review.create
tools.description: Submit an approve, request-changes, or general review without inline comments.

tools.name: github.actions.runs.list
tools.description: List bounded GitHub Actions workflow-run metadata for one repository.

tools.name: github.actions.run.get
tools.description: Read metadata for one exact GitHub Actions workflow run.

tools.name: github.actions.jobs.list
tools.description: List bounded job and step metadata for one workflow run.

tools.name: github.commits.check-runs.list
tools.description: List bounded check-run metadata for one exact commit ref.

tools.name: github.commits.status.get
tools.description: Read combined commit-status metadata for one exact commit ref.

skills.name: github-repositories
skills.description: Find and read GitHub repositories, files, and code through TritonAI provider tools. Use when the user asks to inspect GitHub source or repository metadata without changing it.

skills.name: github-issues
skills.description: Read, triage, create, update, or comment on GitHub issues through TritonAI provider tools. Use read tools first and require enabled issue-write access for mutations.

skills.name: github-pull-requests
skills.description: Read, create, comment on, or review GitHub pull requests through TritonAI provider tools. Never assume gh CLI authentication or merge access.

skills.name: github-actions
skills.description: Inspect GitHub Actions runs, jobs, checks, and commit status through TritonAI provider tools for bounded CI triage.
